description: [compact alias of export_project] Exports the project to a distributable format. Use to build final game executables. Requires export templates installed.

debug.description: If true, exports debug build. Default: false (release)

preset.description: Export preset name from export_presets.cfg (e.g., "Windows Desktop", "Linux/X11")

projectPath.description: Absolute path to project directory containing project.godot. Use the same path across all tool calls in a workflow.

name: export-run
